event_data.context: Baseline: eventcore-v2.1.0 (fea3e386cce904e9ef9b76cd303926870d04a692). PR #2 delivered the optimistic store and OTP adapter. PR #3 delivered execution, discovery, retry telemetry and shared store contract coverage. All 12 tests passed in CI run https://github.com/10krco/eventcore-gl/actions/runs/45472827435 and the App approved fe4b62df9a5739e1a516f3ede3ec39ee31ee9da1. Squash merge: def0bf17c21f3229640f75781bdca0598d7c739f. Acceptance scenarios and linked tests: https://github.com/10krco/eventcore-gl/blob/def0bf17c21f3229640f75781bdca0598d7c739f/docs/parity.md#command-runtime-and-in-memory-store.
event_data.summary: Port and verify the command runtime and in-memory store capabilities of EventCore 2.1.0 on Erlang/OTP.
event_data.title: Command runtime and in-memory store
